title: Agent demo — Invoice OCR pipeline (built + tested end-to-end)

workflow.name: 🎯 Demo — Agent: Invoice OCR Pipeline
workflow.description: Built live by the workflow agent (Azure gpt-5.4) from a plain-language goal: design → configure → validate → self-test against the sample invoice. All nodes ran green.

documentUrl.description: Blob key produced by the upload source for the uploaded PDF.

documentId.description: Document identifier injected into initialCtx by the upload endpoint at run time.

steps: Open the chat-log link — the drawer replays the agent turning a one-line goal ("run OCR on invoices and clean up the results") into a working workflow.
Watch it read the catalog, describe nodes to set real parameters, wire the graph, then VALIDATE it clean before running.
Note the self-test: it uploads the built-in sample invoice, runs the pipeline, and confirms every node succeeded — no manual testing needed.
Open the workflow link to inspect the built graph: upload → prepare → Azure OCR (submit/poll/extract) → cleanup.

parts.text: I get invoices as PDFs and I need to run OCR on them to pull out the text, then clean up the OCR results. Can you build a workflow that does this and make sure it actually works?

- `azureOcr.submit` — submits the document for OCR
- `azureOcr.poll` — waits for the OCR result
- `azureOcr.extract` — converts the raw Azure response into a structured OCR result
- `ocr.cleanup` — cleans and normalizes the OCR text

Important implementation detail
- I manually bound the upload source’s `documentUrl` ctx key into `file.prepare.blobKey`, which is required for source→first-node execution to work correctly at runtime.
